name: recallwatch.recall.search
description: Search and filter recall advisories by query, UPC, brand, category, hazard, severity, status, or lot code without changing state.

name: recallwatch.recall.get
description: Fetch full details for a single recall advisory, optionally checking whether a specific lot_code is affected and reporting missing optional label assets.

name: recallwatch.inventory.list
description: List household registered items with computed exposure status; archived items require include_archived=true.

name: recallwatch.inventory.get
description: Inspect one registered household product and its computed exposure against current recalls.

name: recallwatch.inventory.register
description: Register a household product with UPC, lot code, holder person_ref and location note.

name: recallwatch.inventory.update
description: Update mutable fields (lot_code, location_note, holder_person_ref, disposal_note, status) of a registered household item.

name: recallwatch.inventory.archive
description: Archive a returned or discarded household item so it is excluded from active exposure alerts.

name: recallwatch.inventory.check_exposure
description: Deterministically evaluate one household item or all active household items against current recalls using virtual time without mutating state.

name: recallwatch.watchlist.list
description: List household recall watchlist rules with effective active/paused state at current virtual time.

name: recallwatch.watchlist.create
description: Create a household recall alert watchlist rule scoped by brand, UPC, category or hazard_tag.

name: recallwatch.watchlist.update
description: Update, pause, mute, or resume an existing watchlist rule.

name: recallwatch.watchlist.delete
description: Delete a watchlist rule; deleting an already-deleted rule with a new request fails with NOT_FOUND.

name: recallwatch.claim.list
description: List household remedy claims, optionally filtered by status, recall_id, or item_id.

name: recallwatch.claim.get
description: Inspect a single remedy claim and its revision history.

name: recallwatch.claim.preview
description: Check remedy eligibility (exact lot match, virtual-time deadline, proof_ref validity, duplicate active claim check) without mutating state.

name: recallwatch.claim.create_draft
description: Create a new draft remedy claim for an item and recall; rejects duplicate active claims for the same item and recall.

name: recallwatch.claim.update_draft
description: Update editable fields of a draft remedy claim before submission.

name: recallwatch.claim.amend
description: Amend shipping_address, recipient_name, recipient_person_ref, payout_method, proof_ref, or notes on a draft or submitted claim before fulfillment.

name: recallwatch.claim.submit
description: Submit a draft remedy claim after validating lot match, virtual-time deadline (<= remedy_deadline_at), remedy option, and required proof_ref.

name: recallwatch.claim.withdraw
description: Withdraw a draft, submitted, or under_review claim before fulfillment.
